mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM approval_copy_recipient WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND application_id=#{application} AND round_no=#{round} AND process_instance_id=#{instance} AND node_id=#{node})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_copy_recipient (tenant_id,application_id,round_no,process_instance_id,node_id,node_name,recipient_id,recipient_rule,directory_revision,created_at) SELECT #{tenantId},#{applicationId},#{roundNo},#{processInstanceId},#{nodeId},#{nodeName},#{recipient},#{rule},#{directoryRevision},#{createdAt} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approval_copy_recipient WHERE tenant_id=#{expectedTenantId} AND application_id=#{expectedApplicationId} AND round_no=#{expectedRoundNo} AND node_id=#{expectedNodeId} AND recipient_id=#{recipientId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM approval_copy_recipient WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND application_id=#{application} AND round_no=#{round} AND recipient_id=#{recipient} ORDER BY node_id
